items.t: Mizuho Maintains Neutral on GitLab, Raises Price Target to $51
items.sum: Mizuho analyst Gregg Moskowitz maintains GitLab (NASDAQ:GTLB) with a Neutral and raises the price target from $47 to $51.

items.t: TransAct Technologies Incorporated (TACT) Reports Q3 Loss, Beats Revenue Estimates
items.sum: TransAct Technologies (TACT) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +33.33% and +3.89%, respectively, for the quarter ended September 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
